elements.content: Cover page photograph/graphic showing an industrial facility or plant: a tall striped smokestack emitting dark smoke that disperses into the sky, with large blue steel structures/conveyors in the foreground and industrial buildings/equipment in the background. Overlaid on the lower half is a dark translucent band with a large white chapter number "4" and the chapter title text "Giảm thiểu Biến đổi Khí hậu – Lộ trình khử carbon". A vertical multicolored strip runs along the left edge as a design element. Vertical copyright text on the right edge reads "© The World Bank". The page also includes the series text at top: "Việt Nam: Báo cáo về Khí hậu và Phát triển". Main message: chapter 4 on climate change mitigation / decarbonization, illustrated by industrial emissions.
elements.notes: No data visualization, table, map, or diagram; this is a chapter cover with a background photo and title overlay.
